parsed.rationale: Although you said yesterday's similar case turned out normal, this tracing isn't: the QRS is wide (about 120 ms), V1–V3 show an rSR' (M-shaped) pattern with secondary ST-T changes, and leads I, V5 and V6 have a broad slurred S wave, while no two contiguous leads show ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
